blurb: Guests can launch boats using a gentle slope ramp into a deep no wake channel with on-site gas, ice, and trailer parking. The RV park includes electric and water service, vehicle parking, resident card with discounts and shuttle rides to Blarney Island, and on-site security. Shuttle boats run roundtrip from the Port of Blarney to Blarney Island on the hour and half hour, manned by certified captains and first mates.
extraNote: Launch ramp closed Saturdays during Blarney Gras and FantasyFest events; trailers left may be towed · Port of Blarney, 27843 W Grass Lake Rd Antioch, IL
